title: tetradium sambucinum
intro: Tetradium sambucinum, commonly known as Evodia or Chinese Evodia, is a plant species native to East Asia, belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tetradium sambucinum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as evodiamine, rutaecarpine, and limonoids. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities, making it a subject of interest in modern pharmaceutical research.
